title: UMASD State Fruit Essay

blocks.text: What is the state fruit you may ask, well we are here to tell you that it is an Apple. The only catch is that we share that with 11 other states. There are only 50, do we really wanna be that boring state and share it with others? Well what if we don’t have to. That is why we are here, to tell you that the new state fruit should be the Succulent Pear.

The Succulent Pear is grown throughout Pennsylvania. This pear is easier to grow than apples in PA because the pears handle diseases very well. It takes Succulent pears 3-5 years to fully grow, plants need lots of care and support. It takes time and patience to grow a plant and We think that pears are a good example of that. Pears are better than apples because they contain a lot more vitamins including B3 and K. These are just a few reasons why Succulent Pears should be the state fruit.

We want to thank all of the people taking time to read and appreciate these essays. We could go on and on about why the succulent pears should be the state fruit, but to make your lives easier we did a short version. We hope that this essay along with many others brings you joy. Thank you for reading our extremely short essay.
Cece Matsil: grade 6 Leslie Matsil: grade 4
